# Treasure Hunter
================

A simple text-based adventure game where the player navigates through a maze and collects treasure before the game timer runs out.

## Game Description
-----------------

The player starts at the beginning of the maze and must navigate through it to collect the treasure before the game timer reaches zero. The game ends when the player runs out of time or steps out of the maze.

## Game Controls
----------------

- Use the arrow keys (Up, Down, Left, Right) to move the player
- Collect the treasure by stepping on the treasure location
- Escape the game by closing the window

## Requirements
------------

- Python 3.9+
- Pygame 2.0.1 or higher
- Pyglet 1.5.27 or higher

## Installation
------------

To install the required libraries, run the following command in your terminal:

```bash
pip install pygame
```

or

```bash
pip install pyglet
```

```bash
